# @trysac/llm-sse-parser

> Spec-compliant Server-Sent Events parser for LLM streams with byte-safe chunking, typed Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini text deltas and Last-Event-ID reconnection TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Problem, installation, and usage example.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Modules and boundaries.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): How tests and coverage work.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and memory limits.
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): Objective, scope, and metrics.
